cpp_extension_rule: suffix matched case-insensitively, except that a lowercase .c (C source) is excluded

size_classes.pathological: every generated class-6 file, whatever its size

classes.name: contract
classes.pack_rule: every commit in the pack (each fixture's base and head commits and, for large-review-v1, its epochs); every C++ path in each commit's tree; deduplicated by blob id

recordings.rule: the head side (context and added lines) of every hunk of each C++ file's patch, in order; the recording holds patches only, so the text is the patched region, not the whole head file

classes.name: first-party
classes.rule: git archive of the commit (never the working tree), every C++ path under src/

concatenations.rule: whole first-party files in sorted path order, each ending in LF, added while the total stays at or under the target; size class L; no accuracy labels, because concatenation changes what is in the blob

classes.name: third-party
classes.rule: C++ members of archives the build already pins, verified by SHA-256 and byte size before extraction; never committed

source_trees.name: KSyntaxHighlighting 6.28.1
source_trees.digest_rule: bpr_syntax_source_digest: SHA-256 of the text made of one line '<file sha256>  <relative path>' per regular file, relative paths sorted

classes.name: gap
classes.rule: copied when the directory exists; its labels are written by the integrator, not by label_with_clang.py

classes.name: fragments

excerpts.rule: src/adapters/qt/src/review_cycle_share_sheet.cpp note_code_view::show_excerpt over core::excerpt_note: shown rows only, each followed by LF; tabs expanded to the next multiple of tab_width counted in UTF-16 units from the code's first column; one empty line for each omitted run between windows; line endings (LF, CRLF) are not part of a row

hunks.rule: contiguous original lines (bytes unchanged, original line endings) that begin strictly inside the named construct, found by text search

classes.parent_rule: parents are class 1-3 files that are valid UTF-8 and have at least 30 lines

classes.name: composer
classes.rule: step 000 is the unedited parent; steps 001-150 each apply one edit: typing an enum or namespace declaration a few characters at a time, deleting a block and re-adding it, pasting a 30-line function, or undoing back to an earlier step
